svg.title: Wide forked oak
svg.desc: A low, broad crown of five irregular leaf masses, with a relatively flat top. Thick leaning trunk divides into two long exposed limbs under the canopy. Bottom-centre ground anchor (150, 380). Ducky height 130.

svg.title: Leaning broadleaf tree
svg.desc: Five uneven, notched leaf masses with a lower-right shade and one upper-left highlight. A leaning wood trunk forks into two visible branches. No ground shadow. Bottom-centre ground anchor (130, 360). Ducky height 130.
